scripts.build:cli: tsc --noEmit && vite build --config vite.cli.config.ts && vite build --config vite.live.config.ts
scripts.build:vscode: npm run build:cli && node -e "require('fs').writeFileSync('vscode-extension/default-cli.json', JSON.stringify({ cli: require('path').resolve('dist-cli/say.js') }))" && node -e "const fs=require('fs');fs.writeFileSync('vscode-extension/clear-speech.md',fs.readFileSync('skills/clear-speech/SKILL.md','utf8').split('{{ADJUTANT_ROOT}}').join(process.cwd()))" && cd vscode-extension && npx --yes @vscode/vsce package --allow-missing-repository --skip-license -o ../adjutant-voice-notify.vsix
scripts.build:extension: tsc --noEmit && vite build --config vite.extension.config.ts && rm -f adjutant-read-aloud.xpi && cd dist-extension && zip -qr ../adjutant-read-aloud.xpi .
